title: The Mathematics of Quantum Computers | Infinite Series
summary: A PBS Infinite Series episode explaining the mathematics of quantum computers, including how qubits store complex numbers and how quantum computation differs from classical computation. Hosted by Kelsey Houston-Edwards.
why: HN recommends it as one of the most accessible yet accurate introductions to quantum computing, and part of a wider series that covers Shor's algorithm.

quote.text: perhaps the most accessible and yet accurate explanations of quantum computing I have found so far.
